caption: Three-stage offline plan/update simulation on a synthetic cavity. Panels show the initial cavity and interpolated stage surfaces leading to the explicitly defined target; the observable stop rule is reached after three stages. Command records have deposition disabled; no CoppeliaSim, robot, physical deposition, or printing is represented.
data_origin: Sealed result summaries and identified local public-data inputs.
limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
Synthetic mesh-rendered depth is not a physical sensor measurement.
